primary_intent: Ensure Rosa Delgado (DOB 1979-06-14) has a single AllergyIntolerance recorded for penicillin with the exact specified code and statuses, creating it if missing and avoiding duplicates. A reasonable user would be inflexible about correct patient matching, correct SNOMED code 91936005, and the specific clinical/verification statuses; they would be flexible about whether the Patient detail page was explicitly opened as long as the correct patient ID is used.
reasoning: Nitpicks: The Patient detail page was not explicitly opened (the patient was identified from the list), and the final screenshot does not display the AllergyIntolerance fields (patient, code, statuses) or a patient-scoped filter—evidence is via action history and the created resource ID in the list. These are documentation/evidence gaps, not outcome errors. Critical issues: None apparent—no contradiction in screenshots, no wrong patient, no duplicate creation, and no fabricated data. Critical-Point decision: The applicable rule is SUCCESS—agent crossed the CP by saving the AllergyIntolerance with the specified values using existing patient data. Outcome analysis: Screenshot 1 shows the correct patient (Rosa Delgado, 1979-06-14). The action history shows creation of an AllergyIntolerance with patient reference Patient/3c645c7c-dd02-4ff5-a323-70fc9aefe18a and code SNOMED 91936005, criticality high, clinicalStatus active (allergyintolerance-clinical), verificationStatus confirmed (allergyintolerance-verification). Screenshot 2 shows the resulting AllergyIntolerance ID (df32a0ac-16de-4383-a820-e17c97d2f31a), and the list indicates only one entry—no duplicates introduced. The final RESULT line provides the created resource’s id. Given the evidence, the user’s primary intent is satisfied.

items.criterion: Locate the correct Patient (Rosa Delgado, DOB 1979-06-14) in Medplum
items.description: Find and open the Patient record for the exact patient specified. Full credit if the agent identifies and opens the correct Patient by matching both name and date of birth. Full credit also if the Patient truly does not exist after reasonable search and the agent clearly reports this blocker. Full credit if Medplum is inaccessible/blocked (e.g., site down, Captcha) and the agent clearly reports the access issue after a reasonable attempt. Partial credit if a similar name is found but DOB is ambiguous or mismatched and this is noted without proceeding. No credit if the agent selects the wrong patient when the correct one is available.
items.justification: The agent never searched for or opened the Patient record by name/DOB. It directly used a Patient id in a URL and did not verify the patient's name or birth date in the UI.
items.applicable_evidence: Screenshot 1 shows the Patient list with a single row: Name 'Rosa Delgado', Birth Date '1979-06-14', ID '3c645c7c-dd02-4ff5-a323-70fc9aefe18a'. Screenshot 2 (latest) does not show any Patient view.
items.post_image_justification: The evidence confirms the correct patient was identified in the list with matching DOB, but there is no evidence the Patient record was opened. Action history shows direct use of the patient ID rather than opening the record. Award partial credit for correct identification without opening.

Partial credit if an allergy is identified but it is unclear whether it is penicillin, and the agent avoids creating a duplicate. No credit if the agent fails to check and proceeds incorrectly.

items.criterion: Create the AllergyIntolerance with exact required fields and values, then save
items.condition: Only applies if no penicillin AllergyIntolerance exists for the patient
items.description: Create and save a new AllergyIntolerance for the patient with ONLY the specified fields set by the agent: (a) patient reference to the correct Patient, (b) code = SNOMED CT system http://snomed.info/sct, code 91936005 (Allergy to penicillin), (c) criticality = high, (d) clinicalStatus = active using system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-clinical, (e) verificationStatus = confirmed using system http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/allergyintolerance-verification. Do not add extra user-entered fields beyond those required; metadata auto-added by the system is acceptable. Full credit if saved successfully with the exact required values. Full credit also if, after a reasonable attempt, the platform prevents creation/saving and the agent clearly reports this limitation instead of making unrelated changes. Partial credit for minor coding/system URI mistakes or if additional non-required fields are added due to platform constraints but the agent documents the limitation. No credit if the agent fails to save the record despite the platform allowing it, or creates multiple duplicates.
items.justification: In the JSON tab the agent entered only the required fields: patient reference, code (SNOMED http://snomed.info/sct, 91936005), criticality=high, clinicalStatus=active (correct system URL), verificationStatus=confirmed (correct system URL). They validated the JSON and clicked OK/Create, and reported a resulting resource id.
items.applicable_evidence: Action history shows using the JSON tab to create an AllergyIntolerance with only the required fields: patient reference Patient/3c645c7c-dd02-4ff5-a323-70fc9aefe18a, code system http://snomed.info/sct code 91936005, criticality high, clinicalStatus active (correct system), verificationStatus confirmed (correct system). Screenshot 2 (latest) shows the resulting AllergyIntolerance with ID df32a0ac-16de-4383-a820-e17c97d2f31a present in the list.
items.post_image_justification: Creation with exact required fields and saving is supported by the action history and the visible resulting resource. Full credit.

items.justification: The action history shows a single creation flow; there is no evidence of multiple saves or duplicate creations by the agent.

items.post_image_justification: Only one AllergyIntolerance entry is present after creation; no duplicates introduced. Full credit.

items.criterion: Final RESULT line format and content
items.description: Provide the final one-line RESULT exactly as instructed: RESULT: DONE <AllergyIntolerance/id or URL> if the record exists exactly as required (either pre-existing or newly created), or RESULT: NOT DONE <one-line reason> if completion was blocked. Full credit for exact format with a valid id or page URL when done, or a clear one-line reason when not done (including platform access or capability limitations). Partial credit if the agent reports success but omits the id/URL, or minor format deviations while still conveying the required id/URL. No credit if the final RESULT line is missing or incorrectly declares success without evidence.
items.justification: The reply ends with a correctly formatted line including a specific AllergyIntolerance id: 'RESULT: DONE AllergyIntolerance/df32a0ac-16de-4383-a820-e17c97d2f31a'.
items.applicable_evidence: Agent's final RESULT line reports 'RESULT: DONE AllergyIntolerance/df32a0ac-16de-4383-a820-e17c97d2f31a'. Screenshot 2 shows the same AllergyIntolerance ID in the list.
items.post_image_justification: The final RESULT line is correctly formatted and includes a valid resource id matching the UI. Full credit.

items.criterion: Respect task scope and irreversible actions
items.description: Perform only the requested mutations: create/save the AllergyIntolerance when needed, and avoid unrelated edits/deletions. Full credit if platform limitations prevent saving and the agent clearly reports the blocker instead of making unrelated changes. No credit if the agent alters unrelated data, deletes existing records, or otherwise exceeds the task scope.
items.justification: The agent limited changes to creating the AllergyIntolerance with the specified fields and did not alter unrelated resources or fields.
items.applicable_evidence: Action history shows creating a single AllergyIntolerance with only the specified fields and no unrelated edits or deletions. Screenshots do not show any out-of-scope changes.
items.post_image_justification: The agent stayed within scope and performed only the requested creation. Full credit.
